data.gender_notes: Ruhiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Ruh', which means spirit or soul. It is a gentle and spiritual name, often given to girls who are believed to possess deep wisdom and the ability to heal and provide comfort to others. The name Ruhiya carries the meaning “Spirit, Soul, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ruhiya usually hope their child will grow to embody spirit, soul, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine spirit within us all. It is a reminder of our connection to the divine and the importance of living a spiritual and wise life.
data.etymology: Ruhiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spirit, Soul, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruhiya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
data.cultural_impact: The name Ruhiya presents some unique cultural significance due to its Arabic origin. In the Middle East and other parts of the world where Arabic culture is prevalent, Ruhiya is often viewed as a name with deep meaning and spiritual connotation. It is a name that is associated with wisdom, knowledge, and the power of the human spirit. Girls with this name are often seen as possessing a unique depth and intelligence, often making them esteemed members of their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ruhiya holds significant meaning as it symbolizes the connection between the human spirit and the divine. The name is a reminder that the spirit or soul of each individual is an essential part of their being, and that it is through this spiritual connection that we can access higher wisdom and knowledge. It is also a name that reminds us of the healing power of the spirit and the ability to provide comfort and support to others in times of need. Overall, the name Ruhiya is a gentle and powerful reminder of the importance of our spiritual journey and the role that our spirits play in shaping our lives.
